units.source_text: 此后我再没有见过房东姑娘，同柏木的交往也不像先前那样密切了。

en.t: After that I never saw the landlord's daughter again, and my relationship with Kashiwagi was no longer as close as before.

units.source_text: 柏木的生活方式的魅力尽管仍然深深地吸引着我，但我对此多少也有所抵触，

en.t: Although the charm of Kashiwagi's way of life still drew me deeply, I also felt some resistance to it,

units.source_text: 即使不是出自本愿，也还是疏远了，因为我觉得这样做是对鹤川的一种悼念。

en.t: and even if it was not what I truly wanted, I nevertheless grew distant, because I felt that doing so was a form of mourning for Tsurukawa.

units.source_text: 我曾给母亲去信，信中断然写道：在我出人头地之前，请不要来探望我。

en.t: I once wrote to my mother, stating firmly in the letter: until I have made something of myself, please do not come to visit me.

units.source_text: 这些话先前也曾亲口对母亲说过，可是不再次用强硬的语调写信寄去就放心不下。

en.t: I had said these words to my mother in person before, but I could not rest unless I wrote them again in a forceful tone and sent the letter.

units.source_text: 母亲的回信，用讷讷的词句罗列了一通诸如她勤奋地帮助伯父干农活以及写了简单的训导之类的话，

en.t: In her reply, my mother awkwardly listed things such as how diligently she was helping my uncle with farm work and included a few simple admonitions,
and at the end she added this sentence:

units.source_text: "要亲眼一睹你当上鹿苑寺住持的风采，我死才瞑目。"

en.t: "If I can see with my own eyes the sight of you becoming the abbot of Rokuonji, then I can die content."

units.source_text: 此后数日，这行字使我深感不安。

en.t: For several days afterward, that line left me deeply uneasy.
